description: ONB-04 defaults and merge rules for the user settings file. Each case's input.userSettingsFileJson is the exact settings-file text; CompanionSettingsMerger.MergeUserSettingsFileContentsOverDefaults applies it over CompanionSettings.Defaults. expected.settings pins the full merged settings object with the persisted key names, expected.userSettingsFileWasCorrupt flags the Windows-only corrupt-file rule (adr-derived; UserDefaults has no corrupt state), and expected.unrecognizedUserSettingsValues lists keys this model does not know (e.g. written by a newer Clicky) that must be preserved, not rejected. macOS anchors are the UserDefaults reads at CompanionManager.swift:111-150 (shortcut options at BuddyDictationManager.swift:17-22; analyticsDistinctId is Windows-only, generated where the PostHog SDK would). Parity spec ONB-04, CLA-08; plan WS-12.

cases.note: isClickyCursorEnabled and hasCompletedOnboarding are absent from the file, so they take their ONB-04 defaults (true and false); the other four keys are present and win.
Truncated JSON is unparseable, so every key falls back to its default and the corrupt flag is set; the file is rewritten valid on the next settings change (ONB-04, adr-derived).
hasScreenContentPermission is dropped on Windows (audit D4) and futurePanelSetting stands in for a key a newer Clicky might add; both are preserved with their values instead of being rejected.
